subject: Help fixing cox model with patterns in martingale residuals and broad credible intervals

messages.author: bfc3a63d1f2876d9
messages.subject: Help fixing cox model with patterns in martingale residuals and broad credible intervals
parts:
Dear everyone,

I am trying to fit a cox model with inla but struggle with my model residuals and the credible intervals. I am only able to show the model diagnostic plots but hope you can share your insights if there is anything to be done to fix the errors in the residuals and make the estimates a pit more precise.


I have two         successive experiments including 4 experimental groups with a relatively small sample size and one control group which I fit with

inla(inla.surv(day_study_s, status) ~ 1 + group + mean_vol,
                    data = df, family = "coxph", control.hazard = list(model = "rw1",  scale.model=T)) 


Firstly I fit the first experiment (2022_04_res_exp1.png) where non of the groups are significant. Here CS residuals are to low indicating that the  mice die to slowly compared to the estimated cumulative hazard rate. Further there are negative CS residuals. Martingale residuals show a clear downwards trend where early indexes consist of the control group.


Secondly, I look ate the same default model for experiment 2 (2022_04_res_exp2.png). Now the treatment effect is significant but has broad credible intervals eg.: mean = 0.13 [0.05, 0.33]. Again, CS residuals are lower than the estimated cumulative hazard rate. However, martingale residuals show a S-curve where the control group has lower values than the treatment group. Deviance residuals are relatively broad with overlapping boxes however the control group (G01) clearly has lower residuals than the rest.


Finally, I include prior information from experiment 1 into experiment 2 and treatment effect is again significant with broad credible intervals. Now the CS residuals mostly fit however the pattern in martingale residuals and deviance residuals (i.e. control group has lower residuals) that has been present without the priors is more pronounced.


Do you have any suggestions how to remove this pattern in the martingale and deviance residuals and make the credible intervals smaller? I am thankful for every suggestion.


I already tried stratification to include a different baseline hazard between control and treatment and inclusion of time based interactions as done here (https://groups.google.com/g/r-inla-discussion-group/c/pBF-pbqsMe0/m/eYQExSSHAAAJ) but can't find a solution to my problem.


All the best and thank you in advance,

Markus

messages.author: 953deaf1a512b96e
messages.subject: Re: Help fixing cox model with patterns in martingale residuals and broad credible intervals
parts:
Hi Markus,

It's not easy to figure out what is going on here just with those diagnostic plots. Maybe it is related to the random walk for the baseline risk that is not smooth enough given your small sample size. You can try to switch to random walk of order 2 (model="rw2" in control.hazard) for a more smooth baseline curve.

If you want to give us more information (code, data) so we can look more into it but can't share it publicly, you can us send a message at he...@r-inla.org

Best,
Denis Rustand
